FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Clear answers about the Award, four-task format, timing, dictionary use, grading, centres and app boundaries.

Is this an official Gateway Qualifications app?

No. RushLabs developed it independently. It is not affiliated with, approved by or endorsed by Gateway Qualifications.

What is the exact qualification number?

The Entry Level 2 Reading Award is 601/5416/0 and its mandatory unit is M/506/8491 Reading Entry 2.

How is the qualification graded?

The current qualification page lists Pass grading and task-based controlled assessment.

How many tasks are in the reading assessment?

The current sample assessor pack contains four supervised reading tasks.

How much time is allowed?

The sample pack allocates one hour in total, with 15 minutes as the guide time for each of four tasks.

Can I use a dictionary?

The current sample guidance allows a monolingual simplified dictionary or glossary. Follow your centre's current instructions.

Must all tasks be completed together?

No. The sample guidance permits different sessions, but all four tasks are required and assessment materials cannot be taken away.

Are prior qualifications required?

The current qualification page says no prior qualification or specific attainment level is required, while centres should use initial or diagnostic assessment to confirm suitability.

Does the app use official assessment questions?

No. Its 500 tasks and explanations are independently written.

Which Store is available?

The exact App Store app ID is public. No public Google Play listing was found for the exact package on September 19, 2026.

Does the app issue a qualification?

No. Only an approved assessment process can lead to the qualification.

Is an account required?

No RushLabs account is required. Study records are stored on the device.

Official sources

Use these guides for independent practice. Your approved centre and Gateway Qualifications control assessment delivery, contextualisation, reasonable adjustments and results.
